name: US independent and franchised hotels/motels (often Indian-American owned)
icp: Owners or management groups running 1-20 limited-service hotels or motels in the US (independent or franchised, e.g. Choice, Wyndham, Best Western, Red Roof). Many are Indian-American, family-run, and operate several properties.
disqualifiers: Hotel brand corporate pages or large REIT-owned portfolios
OTA listings or directories rather than the property/management company
Luxury full-service resorts with large in-house teams

pains.pain: Guest messages, OTA inbox (Booking.com, Expedia) and phone calls overwhelm a thin front desk, especially overnight
pains.solution: An assistant that answers guest questions across OTA inboxes, SMS and web chat 24/7 and hands off anything sensitive
pains.evidence_to_look_for: No chat, phone-only contact, reviews mentioning unanswered calls or slow responses, hiring front desk/night audit

pains.pain: Review replies and reputation management across many properties
pains.solution: AI-drafted, on-brand replies to every Google/TripAdvisor/OTA review for owner approval, plus weekly sentiment summaries
pains.evidence_to_look_for: Unanswered reviews, multiple properties, mixed ratings

pains.pain: Multi-property reporting and AP invoices handled in spreadsheets
pains.solution: Daily owner report across properties (occupancy, ADR, RevPAR from the PMS) and invoice capture into accounting
pains.evidence_to_look_for: Management company with several properties, 'our hotels' pages

offer: A 2-week pilot at one property: 24/7 guest messaging plus review replies, then roll out to the rest of the portfolio
guarantee: If the front desk doesn't feel the difference in 30 days, they don't pay the monthly fee
mystery_shop: Call the property at 11pm local time with a simple question (late check-in, parking)
Message through the website or OTA asking about availability and time the reply
tone: Warm and respectful, family-business friendly, practical. Owners are busy, often running several properties.
language_notes: Do not assume ethnicity or use Hindi/Gujarati greetings unless the data clearly shows the owner's name; even then keep the email in English.
